name: aws-console-relogin
description: Chrome extension that signs IAM Identity Center console sessions back in before they expire and restores their tabs.

scripts.package: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/aws-console-relogin.zip && zip -qX dist/aws-console-relogin.zip manifest.json *.js *.html *.css LICENSE icons/*.png && unzip -l dist/aws-console-relogin.zip
